text:
jess: morning async check-in — prelaunch day. Posted three draft posts to the content calendar: product-bench, cost-case-study, and launch-announcement. Need quick review on product-bench (post #2) — especially the alt copy for the hero screenshot and the lead CTA. Publishing target: today 4:00pm PT. Blockers: waiting on screenshots from eng and final CTA from PM.

maya: on it. I can review post #2 by 11:30am PT and leave inline comments in the doc. I like the current headline but will suggest a shorter H1 if needed. :+1:

tom: adding screenshots now — had to tweak the capture script (it was cropping the footer). Pushed images to #eng-assets and updated filenames: `bench_graph_v2.png`, `latency_table.png`. If anyone needs raw frames run: ```./scripts/capture_screens.sh --env=prod --fullpage``` then grab from `/tmp/redwood-captures/`.

jess: thanks @tom — will pull those in. Can someone confirm the image compression target? want to keep quality for the blog but not blow CDN size.

liz-design: aim for <300KB per image for the post hero, 120-180KB for in-article graphs. I compressed `bench_graph_v2.png` to 240KB (uploaded the compressed version with `-compressed` suffix). If you want originals for the docs, they're in the same folder.

nate: CTA options — short list: [A] "Try Redwood Optimize"; [B] "See benchmark details"; [C] "Get a demo". For the product-bench post I lean A or B. If the target is dev-first signups, A. If we want to push enterprise leads, C.

jess: leaning A for blog and B in the release note (we'll A/B test later). I'll add both variants to the calendar entry so DevRel can instrument.

maya: small copy ask — can we tighten the intro paragraph to mention latency numbers up front? I can propose a 2-line variant in the doc.

tom: FYI for publishing pipeline: deploy-bot will run the scheduled publish, but double-check the front-matter: `publish_time: 2026-03-18T16:00:00-07:00`, `tags: [benchmarks, cost, performance]`. If you want to preview the article locally: ```npm run dev && open http://localhost:3000/posts/product-bench```

deploy-bot: scheduled publish set for 2026-03-18T16:00:00-07:00. Reminder will post 1h and 10m prior.

jess: perfect. Action items: @maya — inline edit by 11:30am. @tom — confirm final compressed images in #eng-assets (done). @nate — choose CTA A or B by noon (I need final for meta tags). @liz-design — confirm hero size is the compressed file. I'll do a final sweep at 2pm PT and update the calendar.

maya: noted. will update.

nate: vote A. leaving comment in calendar.

jess: thanks all — ping me if any urgent blockers. :rocket:
